method: Opened all 16 authoritative source PNGs and all 53 delivered crops. Inspected complete crop content and all four edges at native crop resolution; enlarged tight source boundaries. Compared RGB decoded pixels of every delivered image with the source PNG rectangle: 53/53 exactly equal. Checked source_image and pdf_page against sources/index.json: 53/53 agree. Rectangles are source-local [left, top, right, bottom], right/bottom exclusive. Proposed rectangles were rendered to temporary PNGs and visually inspected; none was applied. No retouching, artificial margin, renumbering, or score modification was performed.
margin_policy: Retain genuine feasible whitespace, not a fixed expansion. Very tight natural separation is acceptable only with complete notation and no foreign ink. Isolated scan speckle is distinguished from identifiable foreign characters or handwriting. A null proposal is not authorization to clip, paint, stitch, or otherwise manufacture a clean result.
